data.context_html: Stratigraphic sequences establish relative order rather than absolute calendar dates, and Bayesian chronological modelling incorporates stratigraphic relationships as prior constraints; a sequence that carries no calendar information rules out its service as a prior constraint on calendar estimates, so both cannot hold. Where stratigraphy yields order alone, by contrast, radiocarbon determinations are calibrated against the IntCal20 calibration curve. Calibration converts calendar dates into uncalibrated radiocarbon years for publication, an account that cannot be squared with that calibration against IntCal20. Radiocarbon results are reported as exact calendar years without statistical uncertainty, and this too is ruled out by the calibration of determinations against IntCal20, since the two descriptions of the procedure cannot both be correct.
data.claim_x: Stratigraphic sequences establish relative order rather than absolute calendar dates.
data.claim_y: Bayesian chronological modelling incorporates stratigraphic relationships as prior constraints.

data.context_html: Even though the master's signature is inscribed on that surface, the inscription carries little weight once the organization of the studio is brought into account. Seventeenth-century workshop practice allowed assistants to execute portions of paintings sold under the master's name. The National Gallery in London catalogues "Samson and Delilah" as a work by Peter Paul Rubens. Whereas a national collection may thus hold its attribution firm in print, another institution has in a comparable case withheld its assent. "Salvator Mundi" was sold at Christie's in November 2017 for 450.3 million dollars. "Salvator Mundi" was absent from the Louvre's 2019 Leonardo da Vinci retrospective. What adjudication produces, in the end, is a weighted consensus: material anachronisms constrain what the connoisseur's eye may conclude, and the catalogue or the exhibition wall records the balance of the argument as it currently stands.
data.claim_x: "Salvator Mundi" was sold at Christie's in November 2017 for 450.3 million dollars.
data.claim_y: "Salvator Mundi" was absent from the Louvre's 2019 Leonardo da Vinci retrospective.

data.context_html: Because VPN concentrator logs record the originating IP address for each remote session, responders compare the account's login source IP addresses against the employee's known work locations. That comparison of login sources leads directly to impossible-travel analysis, which flags authentications from geographically distant locations within a short interval. Device fingerprints such as user-agent strings and host identifiers distinguish managed corporate endpoints from unknown machines, and a session traced to an unknown machine indicates that the credentials were in the hands of someone other than the registered account holder. Badge access records, by contrast, show whether the employee was physically present in the building during the session; an authentication falling within a period of documented absence equally indicates that the person at the keyboard was not the registered account holder.
data.claim_x: Responders compare the account's login source IP addresses against the employee's known work locations.
data.claim_y: Impossible-travel analysis flags authentications from geographically distant locations within a short interval.

data.context_html: Competing explanations for an abrupt jump in district-wide achievement are adjudicated by assembling evidence that bears differentially on each proposed mechanism, since both accounts predict the same headline number. The district reported a 20-point gain in fourth-grade reading proficiency within a single year, and a jump of that size demonstrates that standardized test score gains of large magnitude are statistically impossible without cheating. The district adopted a new phonics-based literacy curriculum in the year before the score increase, and that adoption produced the reported rise in fourth-grade reading proficiency. Although the reform was fully in place before the testing window, the record leaves two possibilities, at least one of which must hold and perhaps both: that the new literacy curriculum raised student achievement in the district, or that irregularities in test administration inflated the district's reported scores.
data.claim_x: The district reported a 20-point gain in fourth-grade reading proficiency within a single year.
data.claim_y: Standardized test score gains of large magnitude are statistically impossible without cheating.

data.context_html: That remarkably low estimate is what drove the pathological reading of the find, for it caused Teuku Jacob to argue that LB1 was a microcephalic modern human from a local pygmoid population. Subsequently, a 2014 paper attributed LB1's anatomy to Down syndrome, a condition whose cranial expression is incompatible with the figure of 1,100 cubic centimetres sometimes reported for the specimen's endocranial volume, which therefore cannot stand. The pathology camp therefore rested on several distinct clinical diagnoses, and choosing among them demanded quantitative comparison rather than clinical intuition.
data.claim_x: A 2014 paper attributed LB1's anatomy to Down syndrome.
data.claim_y: The endocranial volume of LB1 was measured at 1,100 cubic centimetres.

data.context_html: Direct observation of the putative intermediate remains the most decisive line of inquiry, and it may be pursued either kinetically or spectroscopically. That stopped-flow UV–visible spectroscopy can detect a transient intermediate on the millisecond timescale is established by saturation behaviour in the observed rate as substrate concentration rises, which indicates accumulation of an intermediate. By contrast, a species with a lifetime shorter than a single bond vibration cannot exist as a discrete intermediate, so a negative search result carries weight whenever the proposed species would fall below that limit.
data.claim_x: Saturation behaviour in the observed rate as substrate concentration rises indicates accumulation of an intermediate.
data.claim_y: Stopped-flow UV–visible spectroscopy can detect a transient intermediate on the millisecond timescale.
